Team — looping in Marissa and Legal. Attached is a quick commit table I modeled after similar deals (RW_Commit_Table_v1.xlsx). Highlights and suggested play: 

- Option A (Aggressive ramp): 60/30/10 over first 4 / next 4 / final 4 months — fastest activation credit.
- Option B (Balanced): 40/40/20 split — smoother cashflow, easier to operationalize.
- Option C (Conservative tail): 30/40/30 — reduces risk for BP, slower redemption.

Legal note (Laura): please draft a short "one-time remediation" clause — allows BP to reallocate unused commitment in month 5 if they provide a PO and evidence of go-live within 30 days. Keep it constrained to one use per term.

Action items:
- Marissa: prepare Private Offer PDF and DocuSign envelope with the selected cadence placeholders.
- Sean: confirm whether BluePeak needs split invoices to subsidiaries.
- Laura: draft remediation language and confirm amortization impact.

Thanks — attaching RW_Commit_Table_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) for the three cadences.

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I've attached our draft private offer (RW_GCP_Private_Offer_v2.pdf) which includes the Option B (Balanced) cadence by default and the remediation clause Laura suggested. Key callouts:

- Commitment: 12-month term, $600k total commitment.
- Cadence (Option B): months 1–4 = 40% of frontquarter, months 5–8 = 40%, months 9–12 = 20% (we show monthly invoice milestones in the appendix).
- Grace clause: one-time make-good if month 3 or 4 misses target AND BP provides an approved PO within 30 days. Make-good limited to 15% of the missed volume.
- Marketplace activation: we can phase the listing; GA listing requires payment of invoice for first milestone. Early co-sell enablement (lead routing to Redwood AE) can begin once PO executed and payment plan agreed.
